title: CI: catch a federated entry pin that moved without a version bump
summary: The manifests check validates federated sources are pinned objects but never verifies the pin actually moved to different plugin content. lore-cli v0.4.3's tag bumped package.json but not .claude-plugin/plugin.json, so opum-lore's OMARK-2 ref bump landed pointing at a tag whose plugin.json version (0.4.2) is identical to the previous pin's -- exactly the class of bug the version guard prevents for opum-workflow itself, but nothing catches it for federated entries. Extend the manifests CI check: for each federated plugin entry whose source.ref changed in the diff, fetch that plugin'\''s .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the base branch'\''s ref and at the new ref (a raw GitHub read per changed entry, not per PR) and fail if the version did not change. Decision recorded 2026-09-05 by this session, per opum-agent (orchestrator) raising it: worth building, because the read is bounded to changed entries only (currently 1, soon 2 with opum-quest) and directly closes the gap that let OMARK-2 land silently unhelpful.

acceptanceCriteria.text: manifests CI check fetches base-ref and new-ref plugin.json for every federated entry whose source.ref changed in the PR diff
check fails the PR when the fetched versions are equal (pin moved, plugin did not)
check is a no-op (no network read) on PRs that do not touch a federated entry's ref
